#502 · Discipline Pokémon

Dewott

Water

Unova · Generation 5

Dewott is a Water-type Discipline Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 0.8 m tall and weighs 24.5 kg. It evolves from Oshawott and into Samurott. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (83), with a base stat total of 413.
